BTS Group Participates as a Co-Host of the Royal Merit-Making Ceremony and Lays a Wreath in Tribute in Honour of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother

Back 27 May 2026

On 27 May 2026, BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited, together with companies within the BTS Group, participated as a co-host of the Royal Merit-Making Ceremony and the Wreath-Laying Ceremony in Tribute to Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother. On this occasion, Mr. Keeree Kanjanapas, Chairman of the Board, and Mr. Kavin Kanjanapas, Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer, together with members of the Board of Directors and executives, attended the ceremony to pay their deepest respects and express their profound gratitude for Her Majesty’s immeasurable benevolence at the Dusit Maha Prasat Throne Hall, The Grand Palace.

During the ceremony, Mr. Kavin Kanjanapas lit incense sticks and ceremonial candles before the Royal Urn of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother, while ten monks chanted Buddhist scriptures. Thereafter, Mr. Keeree Kanjanapas and Mr. Kavin Kanjanapas offered monastic robes, after which the monks performed the traditional Buddhist rites and bestowed blessings. The ceremony concluded with members of the Board of Directors and executives paying their respects before the Royal Urn.

BTS Group remains steadfast in upholding and carrying forward Her Majesty’s royal teachings and noble aspirations, which continue to serve as guiding principles in its operations and corporate conduct. The Group is committed to conducting its business with integrity, transparency, and sound corporate governance, while striving to contribute to the well-being of society and the sustainable development and prosperity of the nation.
